latest.notes:
Songs now carry a vocal gender (Male / Female / Group) and a tempo.

Tempo follows a measured BPM through bands you set in Settings ▸ Scheduling, so one rule sorts the whole library and changing the bands re-sorts it at once — nothing is stored per song unless you set a tempo override by hand.

Setting them: import reads a BPM or gender already in the file's tags; 'Fill Missing Attributes…' measures the BPM from the audio and looks the artist up on MusicBrainz, filling blanks only so it is safe to re-run; the normal metadata editor edits one song; 'Edit Attributes…' mass-edits a selection with every field defaulting to leave-unchanged.

Using them: Gender and Tempo are sortable columns in the Library. A clock slot can ask for a tempo, and reports it when the rotation cannot supply one. Scheduling settings can hold a gender apart so two female-vocal songs never air back to back — and when the library is too thin to keep that, the log report now says so rather than relaxing in silence.

A station that does not turn any of this on behaves exactly as before.
